connector.name: Horizon Fidelity Monitor
connector.registryDescription: Tracks conversation health in real time - drift, desync, and causal collapse - for any AI agent.
connector.summary: Hosted at horizon.leocelis.com over server sent events. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 7 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the leocelis account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: API key for the Horizon hosted server. Request one at https://github.com/leocelis/horizon/discussions
